source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies passive estimation of the largest mean among K distributions, proposes HAVER, and analyzes MSE; it is not a grouped observational causal minimax converse.
The paper gives a necessary-and-sufficient pathwise-differentiability condition for the optimal-rule value and discusses nonregularity at exceptional laws.
The work studies softmax-smoothing inference for maximum-of-scores parameters including optimal policy value, rather than a finite-sample unrestricted d,K minimax frontier.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper uses two composite hypotheses, specially constructed priors, chi-square mixture control, approximation theory, and Hermite polynomials for a nonsmooth normal-means functional.
Theorem 7 states that the 1/14-approximate degree of Boolean OR on n bits is at least square root n.
The paper treats maximal parameters, permits a growing index set under log(p)=o(sqrt(n)), and develops parametric-rate inference rather than sparse-table minimax risk.
The paper studies observational offline multi-action policy learning and asymptotically minimax-optimal regret over constrained policy classes, not oracle-value MSE.
